name: Holy Water
description: A potent consecrated vial reserved for grave rites and hostile profane entities.
narrative_effects: Supports strong purification and banishment framing where sacred authority is recognized.

mechanical_effect.trigger: applied, sprinkled, or used as part of a rite against a profane entity, corruption, or banishment situation where sacred authority is recognized
mechanical_effect.applies_to: strong purification, banishment, consecration, or hostile profane-entity checks where holy water is directly used
mechanical_effect.does_not_apply: mundane cleaning; entities or situations with no sacred/profane relevance; uses that do not expend or apply the vial
